verdict.rationale: Factory documents a dedicated /readiness-report slash command (available in both the Factory App and Droid CLI) that explicitly evaluates a repository's readiness level for autonomous agents, plus a complementary /readiness-fix command to remediate failing criteria. This directly matches the engineering-lead story of running a readiness report against a repo. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of report output or sample criteria beyond first-party docs.
